text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: It's still alive...?!
text_block_list.orig_text: まだ倒れないなんて……！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: I won't make it in time...!
text_block_list.orig_text: だめっ！　避けられない……！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: RRRAAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Knight!
Now's my chance!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン……！！
今のうちにっ──！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GGRRRRUOOOGHHHH...
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Are you okay?! Don't worry, I'll heal you up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン、大丈夫！？　
すぐに回復するね！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for that.
I wish I was strong enough that you wouldn't need to shield me, though.
I hate seeing you get hurt...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……庇ってくれてありがとう。
……わたしね。騎士クンが傷つかなくていいように、
いつかきっと……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: One day, for sure. I'll be the one protecting you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度はきっと、
騎士クンを守れるようになるから……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Yup, I've got everything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
忘れ物は……
なし。
これでよしっと……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Another day, another repeat of that same dream.
The other person in it sure does remind me of Mr. Knight...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日もまた、
騎士クンに似てるあの人と一緒に、
魔物と戦う夢だった。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: He's super kind, and he's always there for me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢の中のあの人は優しくて、
いつもわたしを守ってくれる……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, they really are similar.
I know it's just a dream and all, but I can't shake this feeling I've got.
There has to be some connection between them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン……
あの人とすごく似てる気がする。
あれは夢だって分かってるけど、
それでもあの人と騎士クンには、
何か関係があるんじゃないかって考えちゃう……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey there.
I didn't expect to meet you here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン……？　
やっぱりそうだ。
こんにちは。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Me?
I'm, uh...
I'm considering heading out of town to train up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたし？
わたしは……
街の外で修行しようと思って。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I really, really hate being dead weight.
Everyone's always protecting me during battle, so I want to do the same.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしも、
もっとみんなの役に立ちたいの。
戦いの時はいつも、
守ってもらってばっかりだから。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
You wanna come with me? Really?
Well, I did feel a little... hesitant, if I'm being honest.
So yeah, I'll take you up on that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ホントに？　
一緒に来てくれるの？
……じゃあ、お願いしようかな。
実はちょっと心細かったんだ……
よろしくね。
騎士クン。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
This feels like a good spot.
Monsters are bound to be lurking about this far off the main road—
text_block_list.orig_text:
──このあたりまで来ればいいかな。
街道からも距離があるし、
きっと魔物もいるはず……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: RRRAAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...!
That was quick! We've been spotted, but it's still pretty far away.
We should have enough time to hit it with some magic first...
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ……！
魔物だ……
気づかれたけど、
この距離なら先に仕掛けられる。
まずは魔法で……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Did it just, uh, start dashing towards us?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ……？　
あの魔物、
こっちに走ってきてる……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
N-not good, not good!
Calm down, me! First things first—stop it in its tracks!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どうしよう！？
そうだ、
こっちに来る敵は足止めしなくちゃ……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
S-stay strong! 
Be brave!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゆ、勇気を出して……！
勇気を……！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Nope! Noooope!
text_block_list.orig_text: やっぱり無理ぃー！！！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: *sob*
text_block_list.orig_text: うう……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, Mr. Knight...
You put the time aside to come along,
but I'm just wasting it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン、
ごめんね……
せっかくついてきてもらったのに、
こんなことになっちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Fighting on my own's just too much...
I try to put myself on the frontlines, but my body just freezes up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一人で戦うなんて、無理だったんだ……
前に出ようとしても、
体が動かなくなっちゃう……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I want to change. I want to become stronger.
But it looks like that'll never happen...
choice_data_list: There's no need to fight on your own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
変わりたかった……
強くなりたかったのに……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
text_block_list.orig_text: 騎士クン……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I mean it.
Okay, you're right. Let me give it one more shot.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう……
……騎士クン。
わたし、
もう一回だけ頑張りたい。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
If things go south, then you can help me out.
But I'll give it everything I've got!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメだって思ったら、ちゃんと騎士クンに助けてもらう。
それまでは諦めないで、戦うよ……！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes!
Are you ready, Mr. Knight?
Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
追いつかれた……！
騎士クン、
準備はいい？
……行きます！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Weh!
text_block_list.orig_text: えいっ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Nice, it landed!
text_block_list.orig_text: 当たった！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: RRRAAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Eeek!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃあっ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Knight?!
Urgh! Down you go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン！？
これで……
倒れて！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GGRRRRUOOOGHHHH...
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that, Mr. Knight?!
I did it!
It was close, but I really did it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった……！
やったよ騎士クン！
危なかったけど、
ちゃんと戦えたよ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I'm so sorry!
I got too caught up in the excitement.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ご、
ごめんなさいっ！
嬉しくてつい……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that wound looks pretty bad!
Give me just a sec. I'll heal you right up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン、
怪我してる……！
待ってて、
魔法ですぐに治すから……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
He's always there for me, no matter the circumstances. Just like in those dreams...
That's not good enough, though. I wanna be able to support him, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢と同じだ……
何があっても騎士クンは、
わたしを守ってくれる。
やっぱりわたし、
騎士クンを支えられるようになりたい……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. It's my fault you got hurt.
If only I was stronger. Then this never would have happened...
choice_data_list: Don't apologize. I'm always happy to help you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ごめんね。
わたしのせいで。
わたしが騎士クンを守れるくらい、
強かったらよかったのに……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. That means a lot to me.
Umm... I can't promise that it'll be anytime soon, but I'm gonna
get stronger. Not just for my sake, but yours as well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン……
ありがとう。
……その、
これからも迷惑かけるかも知れないけど……
騎士クンが傷つかなくていいように、
頑張って強くなるから！
